summary: Iteration 5 end-to-end tested (backend + frontend). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass — personal loans (interest + profit_share) compute correctly, /api/projects/{pid}/profit works and gates non-owner, feasibility v2 (project_type, contingency, TDC, cash_in, roi_cash, feasible=profit>0 & roi_cash>=50) verified with 3 scenarios (subdivision feasible 93.5% ROI, revenue-drop not feasible, borderline 40% not feasible), dashboard shape returns net_worth + net_worth_without_debts + debts{property_debt, project_loans, personal_loans, total} and projects list has my_equity/my_loan_share/final_profit, MAISON 7 my_equity math validated (delta = my_pct% × (100k − 40k) = 25% × 60k = $15k), property equity with 50/50 partners increases dashboard property equity by (val−debt)×50% = $300k (NOT $600k), /api/partner/overview returns scope=all with 4 profiles for admin, scope=self for linked partner (simulated via mongosh user_sessions), /api/admin/users/{uid}/partner endpoint present. Frontend: LOGIN OK, cursor:none on desktop ✓, dashboard toggle nw-with-debts/nw-without-debts flips value ($344,597 ↔ $1,569,446) and debts-breakdown line shows only with-debts. Private Loans: interest loan card renders with pl-accrued/return/total-owed; profit_share flow (set MAISON 7 final_profit=200000 via Overview final-profit-input/final-profit-save, then add TEST_L2_UI $100k basis $450k linked MAISON 7) yields EXACT expected values: pl-share=22.22%, pl-return=$44,444.44, pl-total-owed=$144,444 (matches problem spec). Partner Ledger: 4 profile-card-* cards render, profile-card-sanjay opens profile-dialog containing MAISON 7 project data. Feasibility (form open): fs-type-select, fs-type-hint (subdivision helper text), fs-input-loan-amount, fs-cash-required, fs-roi-cash, fs-verdict all present; live compute for subdivision 600k+30k+900k+contingency10%+loan1M+revenue2.2M → TDC=$1,620,000, Cash=$620,000, Profit=$580,000, ROI on cash=93.5%, verdict Feasible. Admin: partner-input-<uid> and partner-save-<uid> present on Yash's row. Investments modal opens; inv-qty-mode-select (Radix), inv-buy-price-input, inv-invested-input all render.

issues: Same as iter 4: the fs-verdict testid node concatenates the verdict label with the helper hint ('Feasible' + 'Needs profit > 0 and ROI on cash ≥ 50%'). Not a functional bug.

Left-over TEST_L1_UI card from prior smoke run was still visible on the Private Loans page (Total owed included $107,995). Test harness cleaned them up. Consider a cleanup helper or admin bulk-delete for stale TEST entities.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py personal_loan_metrics profit_share branch: when loan.project_id is set AND basis_amount is also provided, code uses basis_amount as-is (does NOT add contributions). This matches the 'override' spec (basis_amount takes precedence). Good, but there is no UX signal in PrivateLoans.jsx to inform the user that the override is being applied.

server.py compute_feasibility: cash_in = total_cost - loan_amount can go negative if loan > TDC; then roi_cash divides by cash_in <=0 → returns 0 (guarded). Consider surfacing a validation warning when loan_amount > total_cost since ROI on cash becomes meaningless.
Dashboard.jsx debts-breakdown only shows when withDebts && data.debts?.total > 0 — hides even when non-zero individual lines exist but total rounds to 0. Non-blocking.

server.py _partner_projects: contributions match is case-sensitive on partner name. Since PARTNERS list is stored capitalised (Yash/Sanjay/Pranay/Max) and contribution.partner is stored raw from form input, mismatched casing would silently return 0. Consider case-insensitive match or store lowercased.
PrivateLoans.jsx client-side validation is thin: submitting profit_share with neither project_id nor basis_amount would 400 from server (correct), but no client-side UX blocker before POST. Minor.

Investments.jsx inv-qty-preview visibility depends on BOTH buy_price>0 AND invested_amount>0 — the preview '= X.XXXX shares' won't appear until both filled; consider showing hint about buy_price requirement.

server.py /api/personal-loans loan.date is stored as raw string; personal_loan_metrics uses datetime.fromisoformat which succeeds for YYYY-MM-DD. If a client posts a date-time string with tz, existing tests still pass, but recommend Pydantic date type.
seed_data_creation: During tests: TEST_ prefixed personal loans (TEST_L1, TEST_L2, TEST_L1_UI, TEST_L2_UI), TEST_FS_SUB/TEST_FS_LOW/TEST_FS_BORDER/TEST_FS_UI feasibility studies, TEST_PROP_EQ property, TEST_equity_contrib contribution & TEST_equity_cost cost on MAISON 7, mongosh test.user.* + test_session_* session for self-view. MAISON 7 final_profit set to 200000 then reset to 0. All cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 verified end-to-end. Backend server real-time was ~2026-09-27 during testing (not January), so interest-loan accrued interest for a 2025-09-27 loan came out to ~$4000 (~1yr elapsed). Tests use ratio-based assertions (accrued == amount×rate×years reported) instead of hardcoding time. Feasibility form testids only render when 'New Study' button clicked (component is toggle-based); fs-verdict concatenates label + helper hint (design). Radix Select options: use page.get_by_role('option', name=...).click(force=True) — plain text= selector matches both the hidden native <option> and the visible radix item (2 elements). Investments modal 'inv-qty-preview' visibility requires both buy_price>0 AND invested_amount>0; won't show if only one is filled. Partner overview response shape: admin gets {scope:'all', profiles:[{name,position,personal,projects}]}, self gets {scope:'self', me, position, personal, projects}. /api/admin/users/{uid}/partner uses body {partner_name: str}.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. All 7 iteration-5 features (Private Loans, Shares fractional, custom cursor, equity by %, partner profiles, feasibility v2, dashboard debts toggle) working correctly at both API and UI level. Profit-share math verified end-to-end matches the exact smoke-test example ($100k / $450k / $200k → 22.22% share / $44,444.44 return).
